correctness.rationale: All ADE possibilities for one smooth conic and five distinct lines are A1,A3,D4,D6; pairwise Bezout gives tau=20+t+e+r. Triple intersections among five lines give r<=2; conic incidence gives t+e<=6; hence tau<=28. Merta–Zieliński 2026 Proposition 3.2 excludes tau=28. The explicit polynomial has 2 D6,3 D4,3 A1 using all 20 pairwise intersections; tau=27. Two explicit degree-3 syzygies and determinant -147f are verified by exact integer arithmetic, yielding freeness with exponents (3,3) by Saito criterion.
